do.reason: No condition or amount expresses "if no mana was spent to cast it" about the spell that triggered this ability. ManaSpentOnThis reads only the mana spent on this object's own casting, and this trigger's spell is another object; nothing in the vocabulary asks how much mana was spent on the triggering spell. Dropping the clause would counter every spell, so the whole line is marked rather than approximated.
do.text: Whenever a player casts a spell, if no mana was spent to cast it, counter that spell.
